items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Don Phillips. That was a band from up in Columbus.

ctx.x: What was the name of the band?

Don Phillips. That was a band from up in Columbus. Well, they came from Fort Wayne, Indiana. I remember working here in Madison, Wisconsin at this place called the Broadway Gardens. Anyway, they had a good trombone player who ...(? )... He could read and everything. (?)They let me go.(?) So then... That's when I decided I was going to learn to read. That made me learn to read -- and to write, too. That's when I started doing both. I just made up my mind I was going to do it. So I asked different questions from…
So you didn't go and study or anything.
